podcast.body: This debut album, though not a commercial success and peaking at #164 on the Billboard Top 200, became a historically significant country rock record. It heavily influenced later musicians like Glenn Frey of the Eagles and is considered a foundational album for artists such as Poco, The Eagles, The Rolling Stones, and Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers. "The first album from the burritos, Gilded Palace of Sin, was not a commercial success. In fact, very few of the country rock albums were."
